title: Drake AutoTotem
body:
# Drake AutoTotem

"Drake AutoTotem" automatically detects when you're about to die and moves a Totem of Undying to your offhand instantly.

## COMPATIBILITY:
- Fabric Api

## FUNCTIONALITY:
- Press G to turn it on and off
- It only works on singleplayer
